The '''Validusia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Bes Ber Bikade sector/Legends|Bes Ber Bikade sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It contained the [[Naval Station Validusia/Legends|Naval Station ''Validusia'']].

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The system was created in part by Ansel Hsiao via the Naval Station ''Validusia'', which he created as artwork specifically for ''The Essential Guide to Warfare'' in early 2012. The system was later identified in the Online Companion for ''The Essential Atlas''.
